messages:
marie-logistics: Alert: AWB 776-1122334 (H100 batch) is blocked at FRA. Broker EDI gateway NACKed the manifest; carrier says manual broker review 18-24h. We have 5 priority units that need to land ASAP. hold vs air-split?
eu-forwarder: Confirmed. Partner EDI gateway experienced intermittent timeouts, causing manifest rejections. Manual review will add ~22h. We can split AWB and air-move 5 units next-day. Quote: +€48k FRA->CDG or +€63k FRA->LHR (incl. uplift & brokerage). Need decision by EOD CET.
marie-logistics: @eu-forwarder any customs paperwork missing? last time HS/COO caused a 12h delay.
eu-forwarder: Paperwork complete. Customs flagged a thermal spot-inspection on a 4-unit random sample, requesting depot photos + serial reconciliation before release.
paul-procure: Who are the 5 reserved for? is this for Dedicated pools or installs?
oliver-ops: Those 5 are earmarked for two EU-west Dedicated pools and one enterprise on-prem install window. Delay will block a customer cutover.
mina-sre: Impact if delayed: losing 5 reduces EU-west burst capacity ~12%. Expect queue latency bump ~25% at peak and potential SLA risk. We can mitigate with KV cache routing and pre-warmed smaller nodes for ~12h; beyond that degradation.
marie-logistics: Important: if we split AWBs vendor must guarantee unified RMA flow (no duplicate RMAs). Also need signed depot photo attestation for warranty/insurance.
eu-forwarder: Understood. Warranty and RMA follow serials, not AWB. We'll attach a single RMA ref (RMA-9984) to any split AWBs and include signed depot attestation in the manifest.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-9984 linked AWB 776-1122334. Status: awaiting depot photos and signed attestation.
marie-logistics: Uploading serial list now:
```
serials: [H100-DF9001,H100-DF9002,H100-DF9003,H100-DF9004,H100-DF9005]
```
paul-procure: I'll pre-authorize up to +€48k for FRA->CDG if ops confirms that's sufficient. If ops requires UK route, I'll need finance sign-off for +€63k.
oliver-ops: Legal: capture signed attestation language in RMA notes. ops will not accept ambiguous photo receipts.
mina-sre: I'll flip routing policy to route non-critical inference to US pools as soft-fallback. ETA for policy flip ~12m. If hold extends >24h we need air-split.
marie-logistics: @eu-forwarder please prioritize depot photos & signed manifest. If we don't have confirmation by 15:30 CET we execute air-split to CDG.
eu-forwarder: Escalated to partner ops. They acknowledge EDI outage and opened a surcharge dispute; will attempt partial credit if outage on their side. Prioritizing photos now, update by 15:00 CET.
marie-logistics: Thanks. Keeping thread live — will post photos once received. :thumbsup:
